pages.title: Exotic Matter Crystal
pages.text: Matter with negative energy density, the ingredient general relativity keeps asking for whenever someone wants a wormhole or a warp bubble. The crystal tries to fall upward and slowly drifts toward the ceiling if I let go. Its facets bend light outward, as though the space around it were gently repelled.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)A Pocket Universe whose vacuum decayed unevenly left pockets of negative energy behind, and the Universe Forge froze them into these crystals. Before that I had only seen them shed by Void Wraiths, or sitting in anomaly vaults, quietly pushing the lid up.

Made in $(item)Universe Forge$().$(br2)$(thing)Dropped by$(): Void Wraith.$(br2)$(thing)Found in$(): Anomaly Vault, Bulk Monolith chests.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Dark Sector.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Alcubierre Coil, Dimensional Residue, ER Bridge Thread, Einstein-Rosen Bridge Projector, Entanglement Node, Exotic Matter Singularity, Exotic Solder, Negative Energy Lattice and more.
